Title: Eyes on the Ridge
Details: If the Bloodfang are this bold, something is driving them. The Moonrage hold the eastern ridge - and nobody has looked at their camp in weeks.$B$BGo up there, $N. Don't fight unless you must. Just see what they are doing and come back alive.
Objectives: Scout the Moonrage camp on the eastern ridge, then report to Sergeant Morris Blackwald in Duskhaven.
RequestText: Well? What did you see up there?
CompleteText: Howlers and shadowcasters, gathered together... that is no hunting party. I'll send word to Lord Crowley at once.
